channels.name: Channel 2
channels.topic_prompt: Talk about trending tech products and innovations reshaping daily life. Focus on practical applications, user experience, and real-world impact. Include 2-3 bullet points highlighting key benefits or challenges. Topics should be in English and suitable for short-form video format. Ví dụ: 'Smart Home 3.0: AI và thiết bị kết nối nhà thông minh', 'Metaverse Beyond Gaming: làm việc, giáo dục, and giải trí trong thế giới ảo'
channels.script_prompt: Write an engaging 25-45 second YouTube Shorts script. Start with a surprising hook in Vietnamese or English as specified. Use conversational, friendly tone. Include 3-4 key points or tips. End with clear call to action or curiosity loop. Keep it concise and natural.
